text: Some years ago: Miss Stoner once sees inside the safe, full of papers
why: Helen says in ¶162 that she saw inside only once, some years ago, and that it was full of papers.

text: What is really kept in the iron safe in Dr. Roylott's room? — Helen has seen inside only once, some years ago
why: Holmes's probing in ¶159-161 gives reason to ask what the safe holds, the question does not reveal an answer, and ¶162 states that she saw inside only once, years ago.
